reasoning_content:
I need to:
1. Add @arelorian/core-network to client/package.json dependencies
2. Add dev scripts to root package.json
3. Create a .env file for server URL

Let me create all this:

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Read full package.json
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("cat /opt/areloria/client/package.json")
current = stdout.read().decode()

# Add core-network dependency - inject after @wasd/shared
import json
pkg = json.loads(current)
pkg["dependencies"]["@arelorian/core-network"] = "workspace:*"

# Add core-network to scripts
pkg["scripts"]["core-network:build"] = "pnpm --filter @arelorian/core-network build"
pkg["scripts"]["core-network:dev"] = "pnpm --filter @arelorian/core-network dev"

# Save modified package.json
new_pkg = json.dumps(pkg, indent=2)

sftp = c.open_sftp()
with sftp.file('/tmp/client-package.json', 'w') as f:
    f.write(new_pkg)

c.exec_command('cp /tmp/client-package.json /opt/areloria/client/package.json')

print("✅ Added @arelorian/core-network to 3D client!")

# Also update .env with SERVER_URL
c.exec_command("""echo 'VITE_SERVER_URL=https://arelorian.de' >> /opt/areloria/client/.env
echo 'VITE_WS_URL=wss://arelorian.de/ws' >> /opt/areloria/client/.env""")

# Also update for 2D client
c.exec_command("""echo 'VITE_SERVER_URL=https://arelorian.de' > /opt/areloria/apps/client-2d/.env
echo 'VITE_WS_URL=wss://arelorian.de/ws' >> /opt/areloria/apps/client-2d/.env""")

c.close()
EOF
